title: Battle of Giurgiu (1595)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Giurgiu (1595)", at revision 1382212670, opens: "The Battle of Giurgiu, also known as the Bridge Disaster, took place on 27–30 October 1595. It was part of the Long Turkish War (1593–1606), a border conflict between the Christian powers and the Ottoman Empire over Balkan territories. The battle ended with the combined Transylvanian–Wallachian army driving the Ottomans out of Wallachia, which was completely liberated from Ottoman forces." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q12723161, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "battle between the Ottoman Empire and the Habsburg Monarchy in October 1595, part of the Long War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
